title: Maria's Party
text:
Maria wants to have a party on Saturday. She writes an invitation for her friend Tom. The invitation says to come to her house at five o'clock. Maria will make a big cake for the party.

Tom reads the invitation at home. He thinks the party is a great idea. He says yes and he will bring a red ball for the games. The party will be fun for all the friends.

questions.text: What will Tom bring to the party?
How does Tom feel about the invitation?
Why does Maria write an invitation?
options: She wants her friends to come to a party.
She wants to sell a cake.
She wants to go to school.
She wants to buy a ball.

vocabulary.definition: a card or message that asks someone to come to an event
an event where people eat, drink and have fun together
a sweet food made from flour, eggs and sugar
a thought or plan that someone has

paragraph_translations: María quiere hacer una fiesta el sábado. Ella escribe una invitación para su amigo Tom. La invitación dice que vaya a su casa a las cinco en punto. María hará un pastel grande para la fiesta.
Tom lee la invitación en casa. Piensa que la fiesta es una gran idea. Dice que sí y llevará una pelota roja para los juegos. La fiesta será divertida para todos los amigos.
